scope: Extend the existing source-bound A0 IOI Game of Worlds GLB with a typed local adapter from five declared front-face cube fields to the existing Rose C5 +2 mod 5 operator and Ihara/Hashimoto non-backtracking contract. Expose the exact route 0->2->4->1->3->0, ten directed edge states, zero immediate reversals on the selected walk, a White-outside to O0-Orange-inside to fixed-Ghost-witness return clip, and explicit AM/XY=Inside, VM/YZ=directed seam, PM/ZX=Inside-prime view controls. Add a user-triggered A0-to-101 display loop over the existing A-O-A-prime fold with CARO, CON-DAO zero-seam, AU-NA return and DAO stillpoint display phases. Preserve H5 as the separate open Prime Foldings hypothesis and create no new Study, Navigator identity or relation.

verification.non_blocking_known_error: The outer pre-existing visualization scaffolding emits one MutationObserver observe(non-Node) error. The nested source-bound player renders and all embedded controls pass; the standalone player emits zero browser console errors.

claim_boundary: The GLB is an addressable illustrative inspection object and deterministic engineering build. Legend selection changes material emphasis and can start explicitly named GLB view clips; the three-pulse legend feedback is not a game-state mutation. Outside, Inside 15H and Inside 21H change only camera orbit, target and field of view on the same object. The Inside-Out Fuge clip alternates scale emphasis between RETURN_WHITE outside and O0_INSIDE_ORANGE inside. Ghost 3+1 consists of fixed-position view glyphs on a plane in front of the cube and uses scaling only. The local Ihara×Rose adapter selects five explicit FRONT fields and imports only two already typed finite contracts: +2 mod 5 on a C5 address ring and the Hashimoto prohibition of immediate edge reversal. The selected route 0->2->4->1->3->0 is exact under that declared map, but the map is chosen and does not prove a natural cube graph, shell identity, new Ihara theorem, physical bridge, resonance, causal propagation or game mechanic. White->O0->Ghost is an authored return visualization, not a consequence of the Ihara operator. AM/XY=Inside, VM/YZ=directed seam and PM/ZX=Inside-prime are display and side-bit roles; they do not define a canonical AM/VM/PM operator. The A0-to-101 breath is likewise an authored finite view controller, not a biological clock, physical breathing mechanism, CD identity or proof that A naturally equals 1. O-to-0 and A-O-A-prime to 1-0-1 are declared projections, and CARO, CON-DAO, AU-NA and DAO remain reused Owner display aliases. H5 remains the separate open Prime Foldings hypothesis and is not renamed or rebound. The Q address overlay remains a two-dimensional owner/readout map; only 2501×2=5002 is asserted as exact arithmetic, and 7.83 remains unbound. Edelweiss, OKO, NLK Shell and leaf-pulley language remain view mnemonics. Game of Words has not been admitted to or implemented in World of Games; doing so requires a separate typed word-record, token, position, transition and return contract. The object establishes no shared Number/Word/Graph/World dynamics, new mathematics, Riemann-Ihara identity, physical cube mechanism, scientific finding, Human utility result, Navigator admission or publication authority.
